content.user_title: Build CloudBase Mini Program Database Features
content.value_statement: Mini Program database work requires correct SDK patterns and security rules. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through CloudBase document database tasks.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use CloudBase document database in WeChat Mini Program code.
Guides CRUD operations for collections and documents.
Shows query patterns for filters, pagination, aggregation, and geolocation.
Highlights ownership rules using auth.openid and system-managed _openid.
Routes admin-style database work away from client Mini Program code.
limitations: Does not cover browser applications that use the Web SDK.
Does not implement server-side or cloud function database workflows.
Does not replace CloudBase console setup or permission testing.
Requires existing WeChat Mini Program and CloudBase project context.

use_cases.title: Build User-Owned Collections
use_cases.description: Create Mini Program features where users read and update their own CloudBase documents.

use_cases.title: Debug Query Permissions
use_cases.description: Align client query shape with CloudBase security rules that depend on user identity.

use_cases.title: Design Data Browsing Features
use_cases.description: Plan paginated lists, aggregate dashboards, and location-aware searches for product features.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Collection Query
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to explain how to read active todo documents from CloudBase in a WeChat Mini Program.

prompt_templates.title: Add Pagination to a List
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design paginated CloudBase reads for a Mini Program order list with filters and sorting.

prompt_templates.title: Design Ownership Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review a user-owned collection design and explain the needed CloudBase security rules.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Aggregation and Location Queries
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan dashboard aggregation and nearby-store search for a WeChat Mini Program.

output_examples.input: I need a Mini Program task list with user-owned records.
output: Recommended collection structure with ownership handled by system identity.
Client read and write flow that respects collection permissions.
Testing checklist for permission failures and empty results.

output_examples.input: My paginated order list returns too many records.
output: Pagination strategy with page size, sorting, and count handling.
Index and filter guidance for faster reads.
Warning about unbounded reads in Mini Program client code.

output_examples.input: I need store search by distance inside a Mini Program.
output: Geolocation query approach for nearby store discovery.
CloudBase index requirement to confirm before launch.
Boundary notes for client-side permissions and backend-only workflows.

best_practices: Confirm the code runs in a WeChat Mini Program before using this skill.
Keep _openid system-managed and design rules around real ownership.
Use pagination and indexed filters instead of large unbounded reads.
anti_patterns: Do not copy Web SDK initialization into Mini Program pages.
Do not expose privileged admin operations through client database calls.
Do not weaken security rules to hide query design problems.

faq.question: What SDK does this skill focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on CloudBase document database access from WeChat Mini Program code.

faq.question: Can it help with Web SDK projects?
faq.answer: No. Use a Web SDK skill for browser applications that use @cloudbase/js-sdk.

faq.question: Does it cover security rules?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains ownership checks with auth.openid and system-managed _openid.

faq.question: Can it create backend admin workflows?
faq.answer: No. It recommends moving privileged global access to backend code or cloud functions.

faq.question: Does it support geolocation queries?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers nearby queries and reminds users to confirm required indexes.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is structured for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
